name: Can you add a bathroom to a garage conversion?
description: Yes, but it requires saw-cutting the existing concrete slab to run drainage, vent lines, and water pipes to your home’s existing plumbing system.

mainEntity.name: Can you add a bathroom to a garage conversion?

acceptedAnswer.text: Adding a full or half bathroom is standard when converting a garage into an in-law suite or guest apartment, but it requires slab modifications. Because standard garage floors sit directly on concrete slabs without pre-installed underground plumbing, contractors must saw-cut channels through the concrete to lay new drainage and sewer tie-ins. The project also requires tying into the main water supply and venting waste pipes through the roof. Planning your plumbing layout along a shared interior wall with an existing home bathroom or laundry room can simplify the pipe runs and minimize concrete trenching.
